invariants.rationale: HoodieJavaTable.create likely returns a non-null table when given non-null config and context.
The return value of HoodieJavaTable.create is an instance of HoodieJavaTable.
The created HoodieJavaTable should have the input config object as its associated configuration.
The created HoodieJavaTable should use the provided HoodieEngineContext.
The method likely expects non-null arguments to produce a valid table.
